properties.displayName: OJK - Manual attestation for Ensure all proposed configuration-controlled changes are systematically reviewed, approved
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure all proposed configuration-controlled changes are systematically reviewed, approved or disapproved with documented decisions, implemented according to approved procedures, and thoroughly recorded for auditing and oversight purposes. (Security-Governance-18).

metadata.Description:
Ensure all proposed configuration-controlled changes are systematically reviewed, approved or disapproved with documented decisions, implemented according to approved procedures, and thoroughly recorded for auditing and oversight purposes.
Determine and document the types of changes to the system that are configuration-controlled. Review proposed configuration-controlled changes and approve or disapprove such changes. Document configuration change decisions. Implement approved configuration-controlled changes. Retain records of configuration-controlled changes. Audit and review activities associated with configuration-controlled changes. Coordinate and oversee configuration change control activities.
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure all proposed configuration-controlled changes are systematically reviewed, approved or disapproved with documented decisions, implemented according to approved procedures, and thoroughly recorded for auditing and oversight purposes.
